newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Great River opens joint-venture company.
newsitem.headline: Great River opens joint-venture company.

text.p: Indonesian apparel manufacturer PT Great River International has set up a 50 billion rupiah (S$28.5 million) joint-venture company with Japan's Gunze Ltd, Great River said in a statement on Monday.
The new company, PT Gunze Socks Indonesia (GSI) aims to produce 20 million pairs of socks a year by 2001 in Indonesia compared with its current capacity of 3.5 million pairs a year.
GSI is 70 percent held by Gunze and 30 percent by Great River. It is the second partnership between the two companies, the first being PT Gunze Indonesia, which manufactures sewing threads.

Great River president director Sunjoto Tanudjaja said in the statement issued in Singapore that there is currently no "high quality" socks manufacturer in Indonesia and most such socks are still imported from Japan.
Great River has 17 sales offices in Indonesia, Singapore and Malaysia covering 8,000 customer outlets and operating some 500 of its own shops and boutiques in the region.
The company also announced recently that it will add 100 franchise stores in Indonesia by 1998, the statement said.
